import java.util.*;

public class Cutting {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner input = new Scanner(System.in);

        int n = input.nextInt();
        int b = input.nextInt();

        int[] a = new int[n + 1];
        int[] even = new int[n + 1];
        int[] odd = new int[n + 1];

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            a[i] = input.nextInt();
            if ((a[i] & 1) == 0) {
                even[i] = even[i - 1] + 1;
                odd[i] = odd[i - 1];
            } else {
                odd[i] = odd[i - 1] + 1;
                even[i] = even[i - 1];
            }
        }

        input.close();

        PriorityQueue<Integer> cuts = new PriorityQueue<>();
        for (int j = 2; j < n; j++) {
            if (even[j] == odd[j]) {
                cuts.offer(Math.abs(a[j] - a[j + 1]));
            }
        }

        int count = 0;
        while (!cuts.isEmpty() && b >= cuts.peek()) {
            b -= cuts.poll();
            count++;
        }

        System.out.println(count);
    }
}

        int n = tokens.get(0);

        int[] a = new int[n + 1];

            if ((a[i] & 1) == 0) {

                odd[i] = odd[i - 1];
            } else {
                odd[i] = odd[i - 1] + 1;
                even[i] = even[i - 1];
            }
        }

        int countCuts = 0;
        for (int j = 2; j < n; j++) {
            if (even[j] == odd[j]) {
                countCuts++;
            }
        }

        int[] costs = new int[countCuts];

                costs[index++] = Math.abs(a[j] - a[j + 1]);

        for (int cost : costs) {
